|lore=Introduced during the Clone Wars. 600 meters long. Some have cargo space converted to TIE hangar bays. Still used to maintain an Imperial presence in the Outer Rim.
|printings={{Card versions/Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser (Official Tournament Sealed Deck)}}
|strategy=By Brian Kallenbach<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/sealeddeck/small/dreadnaughtclassheavy.html</ref>

This is the big one! Once you're done drooling over the artwork on this card (created by our expert artists), imagine getting one in every sealed deck game! Add any ability 2 pilot, and you've got a destiny draw. Play with all your TIEs... you're guaranteed to have a way to move them around. The Dreadnaught gives them a power boost, too.

For constructed-deck contests, note that this bruiser is non-unique. It has a little less power than the Victory-class ship, but it's cheaper and has the same forfeit. More than a match for those pesky [[Corellian]] Corvettes, she stands toe-to-toe with the [[Tantive IV]].

Combos:

[[Kessel (Dark){{!}}Kessel]] + Dreadnaught + 4 TIE Fighters: For a deploy cost of 4, get power 13 and forfeit 13 with ability of 6.

Dreadnaught + [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] + [[Vader's Custom TIE]] + [[DS-61-2]] + [[Black 2]] + [[DS-61-3]] + [[Black 3]] + [[DS-61-4]] + [[Black 4]]: Power 28, forfeit 36 and ability 14. There's the real [[Death Star Assault Squadron]], complete with transport vehicle.

A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (stat boxes and corrected game text), meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:OTSD-D-dreadnaughtclassheavycruiser-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser]]: The game text changes: “aboard” is dropped; “here.” becomes “aboard.”. These are the same words as [[Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with a title and a white italic “E”.

The same area of the printed card (scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
